# Connect more numbers

While the account is on the trial, as get_setup_status shows, and after a first useful result, ask once in the conversation whether the business has other WhatsApp numbers: another branch or brand, or colleagues who talk to customers on their own WhatsApp Business.

For each one, create_number_connect_link makes a link that connects that number to this same account, with no login, for 24 hours. Give it to the person, or send it to the colleague's email, the person copied.

The trial includes up to three numbers. Accept "Not now", and do not ask again in that conversation.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#grow-the-account
